design.source_C: Uniform 768 syntactic G/H 2-bit Boolean gate compositions joined by XOR/AND/OR; projected onto unique 8-bit 3-input truth tables with exact multiplicities
design.exact_observation_marginalization: Every 8 choose k observation mask and every possible response signature weighted by correct actual source-class prior; no Monte Carlo
design.forecast_metric: Expected Brier only on unobserved truth-table patterns k=0..7, over actual mixture source prior. Compare actual-pi Bayes optimum, fixed-50%-pi Bayes mixture updated by likelihoods, uniform rule-prior 0.5 baseline, evaluator-private true-class oracle lower bound.
design.classification_metric: Exact MAP class accuracy (may be dominated by majority class), irreducible error, conditional source entropy and mutual information

exact_verification.direct_768_program_vs_projected_256_tabl: Each selected original observation-mask response signature recomputed by an independently structured program-space sum, compared with law-space projected likelihoods and predicted bit masses at 1e-12.

raw_original_artifacts.OS_difference: Equivalent exact mathematical output within floating-point epsilon (typically <1e-15), plus different whole-analytic-process CPU timing; original JSONs intentionally preserved unchanged.

balanced_uniform_class_prior.formal_reason: Bayes posterior mixing given correct class prior and exact evidence already minimizes expected squared loss; a discriminative source classifier cannot beat it without additional information or model mismatch.

skewed_priors.warning: These are theoretical benefits of knowing true source population mix—not from a trained class selector, and majority-class MAP accuracy can be high even without observations.

next_substantive_boundary.name: T43 — Information-efficient intervention design or calibrated causal program evidence
next_substantive_boundary.options: Before training another costly classifier, test whether source-blind adaptive choice of which causal pattern to observe can materially increase predictive utility (Brier + information per observation) beyond fully informed optimal exact active-query policy, under genuinely matched information. Otherwise work on a cheaper accurate probabilistic causal program posterior with native proof.
next_substantive_boundary.protocol: Freeze source-free analytic active-query controls first; do not create prospective source-born graphs merely to advance a gate or replay consumed T41 cases. Exact 256-rule certification and source identity safeguards retained.
next_substantive_boundary.acceptance: Only after mathematically demonstrable trainable policy advantage against equally trained optimal exact controls, and complete native CPU/RSS nonregression on fresh independent source families.
